scope: Static source and syntax review only; no browser/WASI host transport run, Cargo process, or acceptance claim.

review.utf16: offsetAt treats JavaScript string indices as UTF-16 code units and refuses a position between a high and low surrogate; declaration/call locations are derived from the exact fixture text.
review.captured_edit: The edit must target only the fixture URI, contain exactly two non-overlapping replacements of host_old with host_new, and reconstruct source.replaceAll(host_old, host_new). documentChanges text edits must target version 1 when a version is supplied; resource operations and wrong source spans/newText fail.
review.readiness: currentDiagnostics is queried for exact URI/version/full source. Only unavailable pending/stale responses are retried; complete requires matching URI/version/source, numeric revision and inputsEpoch, nonempty resultId and diagnostics array. This command reborrows the existing completed publisher and does not schedule analysis.
review.first_answers: After each complete-source receipt, exactly one definition and one references query are made for each revision; targets must equal the exact declaration and call locations. There is no naming-query retry or expected-answer convergence loop.
review.host_wiring: The browser publishes the fixture through its VFS before didOpen; WASI opens the fixture under the existing preopened root. Both call after their established workspace-session work. The browser request wrapper supplies its own bounded race because its Session.request ignores the optional budget argument; WASI forwards its existing reply budget.

protocol_version_limit: WorkspaceEdit.changes entries carry no document version by LSP design. They are bound to the captured version-1 source by immediate request/application ordering and exact source-span checks. documentChanges may carry null per the protocol; explicit versions are restricted to 1. URI and edit completeness remain strict.
limitations: No host binary/transport execution was performed.
This is syntax/static review only and does not establish runtime behavior, host parity, or release admission.
